sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/9] Gymnasts scored relatively high on mastery climate, friendship quality, coach relatedness, teammate relatedness, and self-esteem, and relatively low on performance climate and disordered eating. However, gymnasts used the full range of scores for all variables indicating they varied from lower to higher on social, cognitive, and well-being constructs. In terms of T1 physical maturity, most 10- to 12-year-olds were premenarcheal and most 16- to 18-year-olds were postmenarcheal. However, considerable variability was apparent especially with 13- to 15-year-olds, which is typical of the competitive gymnastics subculture.
